skillFull: Boards the Star Voyage Express and flies off at certain intervals. While in flight, star clusters appear flying past the train to the right. For each star cluster collected the train increases in speed and its smokestack lets out a certain amount of Milky Way Star Jellies. Level up for more points for Milky Way Star Jellies.
story:
Take a handful of star powder gathered from all over the Milky Way Galaxy, illuminate it with delicate moonlight—and voilà! Meet Milky Way Cookie, the Slumbering Moon's faithful servant and the conductor of the Star Voyage Express that will take you to your sweetest dreams and back.

Don't be afraid and hop on: one sprinkle of Milky Way Cookie's star powder is enough for a colorful, vibrant dream—just like reality but better! Everything is possible in the World of Dreams, and accidents happen, too: every now and then, the train's floor disappears, and cars reshuffle randomly, leaving crowds of passengers in utter confusion. And right in the middle of the conductor's scheduled nap time! But professionalism never betrays, and there is no problem Milky Way Cookie can't sort out.

Colorful hair neatly tied with a Star Jelly, conductor's hat on, and choo choo! The Star Voyage Express will deliver you to your dreamy destination according to the schedule. Just make a wish upon a shooting star...!

costumes.info: Upon the night of the full moon, if you slip into your favorite pajamas and wait, you might just hear an unfamiliar sound from just outside your window. Take a glimpse outside and you'll see it's none other than Milky Way Cookie, choo choo!-ing her wat over to guide you into dreamland! Follow the sound and before you know it, you'll be deep, deep asleep. A good night's sleep with a cozy, relaxing dream sounds like an exhausted Cookie's dream come true!

costumes.info: Something feels different about the Star Voyage Express! The interior is bathed in pink colors and sweet candies... and then the conductor herself appears—just as adorably decorated—as she hands you a bouquet of strawberry candies! According to the Cookie, it's a special treat just for today's passengers. Imagine how sweet it would be to travel the dream world if every day was like this!

costumes.info: In place of a certain engineer who has not yet arrived to the World of Dreams, Milky Way Cookie has taken the helm of the dream's Star Coal Express! While shoveling Star Coal into the furnace, the dancing sparks have a way oof completely stealing her attention, but don't worry! With her capable crew of Coco Drop helpers keeping everything on track, the train runs smooth as ever. Now then... the dream passengers at the Pancake Tower are waiting! All aboard, CHOO CHOO!
